description: This file defines the interface and data structures for plugins in the lighttpd server, including callback types, plugin structure, options, actions, and server state management functions.

methods.name: li_plugin_register
methods.description: Registers a new plugin with the server, initializing it with provided callback.

methods.name: li_plugin_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a plugin.

methods.name: li_server_plugins_init
methods.description: Initializes plugin subsystem for the server.

methods.name: li_server_plugins_free
methods.description: Frees plugin resources for the server.

methods.name: li_release_optionptr
methods.description: Releases or resets an option pointer value.

methods.name: li_plugins_prepare_worker
methods.description: Prepares plugins in worker thread context.

methods.name: li_plugins_worker_stop
methods.description: Stops plugin activities in worker thread.

methods.name: li_plugins_handle_close
methods.description: Handles plugin cleanup on connection close.

methods.name: li_plugins_handle_vrclose
methods.description: Handles plugin cleanup on vrequest close.
